response.overview: "Mtatsminda" – Documentary, 35mm, B&W, 2 reels (16 min). Educational Film Studio, 1980.  Author and Music: Vazha Zubashvili  Cinematographers: Leri Mikhanashvili,  Malkhaz Kvelashvili.  Editor: Manana Kobakhidze  Sound Engineer: Vasiko Arveladze  Film Director: Otar Koptonashvili  "Mtatsminda" the Pantheon of Georgian Writers and Public Figures is presented here as part of a tourist route. The juxtaposition of value and reality lends a sarcastic tone to the film and an ironic resonance to its title. It was shot in a reportage style, employing the method of prolonged observation. The film received a diploma at the "Molodost-80" International Youth Film Festival in Kyiv.
